text:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO breach detected for /v1/generate (model=redwood-13B-int8-v2).
Summary: p95 ~ 420ms -> 900ms, p99 ~ 1.5s -> 2.8s over last 10m. Increased streaming stalls, multiple sessions timed out. Auto-remediation not triggered.
Link: https://dash.reddemo/internal/d/latency/model-redwood-13B-int8-v2?orgId=1 :eyes:

opsbot: paging mira (oncall) and devon. Escalation level: P1 -> ops bridge

mira: on it. joining bridge now. can someone post the last deploy/change? did auto-calib run in the last 30m?

devon: I didn't push anything to prod in the last 2 hours. I see an auto-calibration job started 00:12 UTC that applied a new precision profile for int8: `precision-autocalib v2 -> int8-calib-2026-03-15`.

sam_w: customers reporting degraded streaming experience (chat) — CS ticket count up 14 in last 15m. Some describe repeated "stall then continue" behavior.

ingrid: metrics snapshot: request rate steady, error rate low, but tail latency exploded. KV cache hit ratio dropped 85% -> 48% around the same time.

mira: that smells like calibration fallout invalidating precomputed KV prefixes or changing kernel selection -> cache mismatch. Can you pull the inference node logs around the calib apply? also which nodes rolled the new profile?

devon: grabbing logs now.

devon: paste from node-322 logs (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-15T00:12:03Z] INFO precision-autocalib: applying profile int8-calib-2026-03-15 to pool=gpu-pool-eu
[2026-03-15T00:12:07Z] WARN runtime: kv-cache-flush triggered due to profile-change
[2026-03-15T00:12:07Z] ERROR runtime: dequantize-fallback mismatch: expected-kernel=fast_deq_v2 got=legacy_deq -> recompile-path
[2026-03-15T00:12:09Z] INFO runtime: streaming-session 0x7f9e reattach failed: partial-kv-miss
```

mira: yep. profile applied -> forced cache flush -> a lot of streaming sessions hit partial KV misses and forced recompile which spikes tail. Also the dequant fallback path seems slower. Repro plan: route a small % of traffic to fp16 variant and measure.

opsbot: action created INC-613999 oncall -> mira, primary contact devon. Notifying CS: eva_cs.

mira: mitigation step 1: temporarily route 30% of /v1/generate traffic away from redwood-13B-int8-v2 to redwood-13B-fp16-stable. How do we do route change? opsbot give the traffic-split command.

opsbot: run:
```
rccli route update --route /v1/generate --split "redwood-13B-int8-v2:70,redwood-13B-fp16-stable:30" --reason "auto-calib fallout mitigation"
```

devon: applying now.

devon: done. split applied. waiting 2 min for metrics.

ingrid: early numbers show p99 for int8 path still ~2.6s but fp16 path p99 ~420ms. Overall p99 dropped from 2.8s -> 680ms across the route. KV hit ratio for int8 nodes still low, but overall request success returned to acceptable levels.

mira: good. mitigation 2: scale-up any warm fp16 workers for the route and disable auto-apply for precision-autocalib until follow-up postmortem. devon can you pin that job?

devon: disabled auto-apply for `precision-autocalib v2` and scaled fp16 pool +2 replicas. Command run:
```
rccli config set precision-autocalib.auto_apply false --org redwood
rccli pool scale gpu-pool-eu-fp16 +2
```

mira: CS update please (eva_cs) — short statement for customers and which tenants impacted.

eva_cs: sending a note to impacted customers: "We observed higher than normal latency and streaming stalls for some sessions between 00:12-00:40 UTC due to an automated precision profile update. We routed traffic to a stable fp16 variant to mitigate impact. Our engineers are investigating root cause and will follow up with remediation and timeline." :mailbox_with_mail:

sam_w: ticket queue dropped to 3 after routing change. one paying customer (org: AlderBio) reported a 6s stall earlier but appears recovered now.

mira: root-cause hypothesis for now: auto-calib changed kernel/quantization path which invalidated KV cache and forced fallback dequant path on several model shards -> higher compile/exec tail times and streaming partial reattaches. Action items:
- devon: gather full node logs + list of nodes that applied the profile (due EOD)
- ingrid: run a micro-benchmark replicating partial KV-miss + dequant fallback to quantify p95/p99 delta (due tomorrow AM)
- sam_w / eva_cs: list impacted tenants + postmortem CS timeline (due EOD)
- mira: produce hotpatch plan for safe auto-apply rollback and add gating for KV-cache-preservation (due next 24h)

devon: logs + node list uploaded to INC-613999 artifact storage: https://artifacts.reddemo/incidents/613999

ingrid: quick repro script I used attached below (dev note):
```
# simulate partial kv miss
python tools/repro_kv_miss.py --model redwood-13B-int8-v2 --seq 2048 --sessions 500 --rate 50
```

mira: are we comfortable moving to P2 and closing the active paging bridge? current overall p99 is ~650ms and error rate normal.

eva_cs: CS happy to stand down paging, we still need the postmortem and customer follow-ups. leaving a watch for 2 hours.

mira: ok closing active P1 bridge; INC-613999 remains open for postmortem + follow-ups. manual rollback of the precision profile is blocked (it would reintroduce previous mismatch) so we will instead revert auto-apply and add a canary step to the calib pipeline.

devon: noted. I'll prepare a canary job: `precision-autocalib canary --percent 5 --verify kv-hit-stable`.

mira: thanks all. sending retrospective invite for 0900 UTC tomorrow. please add repro notes and any traces to the incident doc.

opsbot: incident INC-613999 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring

mira: (reaction :thumbsup:) closing active page. follow-ups assigned in INC-613999.
